Latest Edition · Week 6 · Out Now

The Perfect Season
Is Dead

Six weeks of strutting, one afternoon of shame. lotes — a 1–4 team with nobody over 20 points — walked into Honk Dawgs' house and ended the last perfect season in Big Ballers, 104.4 to 87.9. The full Week 6 paper has the autopsy.

There is no star to credit, because lotes didn't bring one. Bryce Young led the lineup at 19.8 — ten starters, not one of them over 20 points, and the last perfect season in Big Ballers is dead at the hands of a team that owns the second-fewest points in the league. This wasn't a heist. It was erosion.

Honk Dawgs, meanwhile, finally played like the team Fraud Watch has been describing for two weeks. James Cook did his part with 22.8 — and Cam Skattebo, started in the biggest game of the Dawgs' season, scored exactly 0.0.

"Our best player scored 19.8 and we ended a perfect season. Imagine what we'd do with a good player." — lotes, after the game
